title: Kiln source receipts (<data>/updates/receipts.json), format 1
description: Written by the launcher and kiln (kiln_manage::updates::receipt). What Kiln observed when a library entry was installed or imported, and which update source is accepted for a mod. Update checks read it to tell "the same version, published again" from "up to date", and to hold a changed source back until the player confirms it. Nothing here is a guess: a field nobody observed is null. The file never holds a credential, an account name or a path of this PC.

policyVersion.description: The version of the update-check rules this file was last written under.

receipts.description: One per library entry Kiln saw arrive, by kind, id, version and hash.

sources.description: One per mod (kind and id, across versions): the source accepted for it.

hash.description: The entry's content hash (kdh1; sha256 for a plugin DLL).

provider.description: local: an archive the player imported by hand (its digest is known, its origin is not).

destination.description: owner/repo for github, enshrouded for nexus, empty for local.

modId.description: The mod's id at the provider (Nexus Mods: the page's number); the library id for local.

installedVersion.description: The version as the provider named it at install (Nexus versions are free text); the library version for local.

releaseId.description: GitHub: the release's id. null for an archive imported by hand.

assetId.description: GitHub: the id of the release asset. null for an archive imported by hand.

artifactSha256.description: SHA-256 of the archive the entry was unpacked from. One archive that holds several mods gives each the same value. null: imported from a folder, or installed before receipts existed.

fileChainId.description: Nexus Mods: the global id of the file (the chain of its versions).

fileVersionId.description: Nexus Mods: the global id of the installed version of that file.

metadataSha256.description: SHA-256 of the release's kiln-release.json, when an install read one.

destination.description: What "the same source" is compared by: owner/repo in lower case for github, enshrouded/<mod id>/<file chain id> for nexus.

origin.description: Why this is the mod's source: the player's mapping, an install receipt, or the manifest's "updates". Also the order in which they win.

spec.description: A manual mapping's source, in the shape of the manifest's "updates" (kiln.mod.schema.json). Absent for the other origins: the source is read from the receipt or the manifest. A manual mapping says where to look; it is not evidence that the installed files came from there.
